title: Different arrows on watch and phone
symptom: Watch and phone showing different arrows but same numbers. The wear arrow is the same as the one at the original dexcom receiver.
cause: The thread suggests that xDrip is sending the arrow derived by the G6 (Dexcom) to remote systems like the watch, rather than its own calculated arrow, leading to inconsistency. This is based on user deduction, not confirmed by developers.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. A workaround suggested is to change the Arrow trend to the new version by long pressing on the xDrip logo (blood drop) to open settings and activate the last option, but this only affects the app display, not the watch.
evidence_quote: I think the problem is that although the xDrip is working out what the arrow should be, it is in fact sending the arrow that the G6 has derived instead.
